related.title: CSV 資料契約：編碼、引用、型別與可重現匯入
related.titleEn: CSV contracts: encoding,quoting,types and reproducible import
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：讓兩個writer讀同版資料，檢查commit競爭後何者需重算。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Have two writers read one version and determine which must recompute after competing commits. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用標準CSV parser讀含逗號、換行與前導零ID，建立可追溯資料契約。
related.differenceEn: Use a CSV parser for commas,newlines and leading-zero IDs with a traceable data contract.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 樂觀並行控制先準備寫入，再驗證讀寫集合與新的表版本；不能把所有append與update視為同樣衝突。 教學基準：100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock；第二檢核：100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
CSV是有引用規則的紀錄格式，不能用split逗號或逐行當紀錄；型別與編碼需額外契約。 教學基準：10+20+30 = 60 amount total；第二檢核：3 = 3 logical records。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Optimistic concurrency prepares writes then validates read/write sets against new versions; appends and updates need not conflict identically. Teaching baseline: 100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock; second check: 100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

CSV has quoting rules and cannot be parsed by comma splitting or treating every line as a record; types/encoding need contracts. Teaching baseline: 10+20+30 = 60 amount total; second check: 3 = 3 logical records. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ECMA-402 Intl：語系協商與複數訊息
related.titleEn: ECMA-402 Intl: locale negotiation and plural messages
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：讓兩個writer讀同版資料，檢查commit競爭後何者需重算。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Have two writers read one version and determine which must recompute after competing commits. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 先依使用者明選、navigator.languages、預設順序協商，再列出有效訊息與fallback來源。
related.differenceEn: Negotiate explicit choice, navigator.languages and default in order, then list valid messages and fallback sources.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 樂觀並行控制先準備寫入，再驗證讀寫集合與新的表版本；不能把所有append與update視為同樣衝突。 教學基準：100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock；第二檢核：100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

語系標籤、數字格式與複數類別分開處理；可格式化某語系不代表應用所有課文已有翻譯。
教學基準：8/12*100 = 66.6666666667 percent_or_keys；對照：12-8 = 4 percent_or_keys。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Optimistic concurrency prepares writes then validates read/write sets against new versions; appends and updates need not conflict identically. Teaching baseline: 100-30-20 = 50 serially correct stock; second check: 100-20 = 80 stale overwrite candidate. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Locale tags, number formatting and plural categories are separate concerns; formatting support does not imply translated application content.
Teaching baseline: 8/12*100 = 66.6666666667 percent_or_keys; comparison: 12-8 = 4 percent_or_keys.
